description: Source code for ABitReader and NALBitReader classes, implementing bitstream reading functionalities in Android's media framework.

classes.name: ABitReader
classes.description: Class for reading bits from a byte stream.

classes.name: NALBitReader
classes.description: Derived class for reading bits with emulation prevention byte handling in NAL units.

methods.name: fillReservoir
methods.description: Fills the internal reservoir with up to 4 bytes from the data stream.

methods.name: getBits
methods.description: Reads n bits from the stream.

methods.name: getBitsWithFallback
methods.description: Reads n bits with fallback value if reading fails.

methods.name: getBitsGraceful
methods.description: Attempts to read n bits gracefully, returns false if not enough bits.

methods.name: skipBits
methods.description: Skips n bits in the stream.

methods.name: putBits
methods.description: Puts n bits into the reservoir.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to current data position.

methods.name: atLeastNumBitsLeft
methods.description: Checks if at least n bits are left, considering emulation prevention bytes.

methods.name: fillReservoir (NALBitReader)
methods.description: Fills reservoir with up to 4 bytes, skipping emulation prevention bytes.
